events.body:
## Bug

`website/views/issue.py:2772` does `client = OpenAI(api_key=openai_api_key)`, but `OpenAI` is never imported in the module. The code checks `OPENAI_API_KEY` just above and proceeds when it is set, so with a key configured this line raises `NameError: name 'OpenAI' is not defined`.

## Repro

Set `OPENAI_API_KEY` and invoke the AI issue helper that reaches line 2772 → NameError instead of calling the API.

## Suggested fix

    from openai import OpenAI

This is the import pattern already used elsewhere in the codebase.

Found by static analysis (ruff F821); no star-import masks the name. AI model used in analysis: Claude Opus 4.8 (Claude Code).
